description: Is a given user agent allowed to fetch this URL under the site's robots.txt (RFC 9309 longest-match rules)? Returns allowed, matched_rule, crawl_delay, declared sitemaps, a per-bot verdict for 20 AI/search crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot...), and whether the site publishes /llms.txt.
name: check_robots
title: Check robots.txt rules for a URL (incl. AI bots)
